newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BOND MKT PRIMARY DEALERS TO REPORT TO CSD.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BOND MKT PRIMARY DEALERS TO REPORT TO CSD.

text.p: Primary dealers on the Finnish bond market will start reporting to the Central Securities Depository (CSD) in August and cease reporting to the Bank of Finland, the central bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
"The Finnish Central Securities Depository will assume full responsibility for trades reporting and provision of market information with effect from August 1, 1997," the Bank of Finland said.
"This means that primary dealers will report to the Bank of Finland for the last time on July 31, 1997," it said.
The transfer was part of arrangements for changing the reporting of trading in government benchmark bonds, the central bank said.
The new arrangement also entailed a simplified counterparty classification.

"Trades effected by primary dealers will be classified by counterparty into two categories: trades between primary dealers and trades between primary dealers and customers," it said, adding the existing category 'with other banks' would be included in customer trades.
CSD will publish information about bond market transactions on Reuters page, the Bank of Finland said.
